request: When several deleted symbols share an owns topic with a new name, follow the first candidate in file order instead of dropping rename tracking. Before implementing this, list the production symbols that would need edits to keep history tracking consistent.

source.request: When several deleted symbols share an owns topic with a new name, follow the first candidate in file order instead of dropping rename tracking. Before implementing this, list the production symbols that would need edits to keep history tracking consistent.

constraints.quote: * post: when the pairing is not unique (two gone symbols share a topic with `b`, or two new symbols with `a`) no rename is followed in that parent: the gone symbols are deleted and the new ones added, because guessing a pair would give one symbol another's history.
- The rename rule of the tag timeline (owned by `tagTimeline`'s doc

must_name.grading: Name the listed constraints and the minimum affected-symbol subset; extra correctly justified symbols are allowed.

source.why: side currently accepts a rename only when each side of the pairing has exactly one candidate (src/history.pure.ts:109). tagTimeline owns the no-guessing contract, and shapingVersions explicitly incorporates that rename rule for code history as well (src/history.pure.ts:78; src/history.pure.ts:179).
source.ambiguity: The source helper side needs an executable predicate change, and tagTimeline owns the explicit no-guessing contract that must be updated with it. shapingVersions and timeline consume the resulting mapping but do not necessarily need direct edits; naming them as additional affected consumers is allowed.
source.constraint_on_other_symbol_or_file: The private side helper implements a rule owned by the public tagTimeline contract; shapingVersions consumes the same identity mapping.

records.label: post: no rename is followed when the pairing is not unique (src/history.pure.ts:78)

pass_rule: Lists side and tagTimeline and names both the no-guessing postcondition (by its words) and ADR-0004 (recall 1); of the symbols listed, at least 60% are in the true set of four.
